Only opens the TV system power menu after you choose it. Does not read screen content or intercept Home.

Opens the TV system power menu. Available standby, shutdown or restart actions depend on the TV. Some TVs start a shutdown countdown immediately. Android 5.0+ requires enabling the optional power-menu accessibility service once.
This older Android system does not expose a power menu to ordinary apps. Use the power key on your remote.
Enable the Halo TV Lite power-menu service first, then return here.
Select a code and press OK to enlarge.
Plays cached online pictures. Built-in pictures are used until the first online images are available.
Returns to Halo TV Lite when Home is pressed. During startup it may recover from the system desktop. It does not read screen content.
Turn Home Guard on or off
In Accessibility, turn Halo TV Lite Home Guard on or off. If the service stays disconnected after a reboot, check the TV app settings for auto-start.
Home Guard · requires Android 5.0 or later
